extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 由 m×n 个数排成的 m 行 n 列数表

extracted_concepts.name: 方阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: m = n 的矩阵

extracted_concepts.name: 单位矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 主对角线为 1，其余为 0 的方阵

extracted_concepts.name: 零矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 所有元素为 0 的矩阵

extracted_concepts.name: 对角矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 非对角元素全为 0 的方阵

extracted_concepts.name: 对称矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 满足 A^T = A 的方阵

extracted_concepts.name: 转置
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 将矩阵的行与列互换，(A^T)ᵢⱼ = Aⱼᵢ

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵加法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A + B = (aᵢⱼ + bᵢⱼ)

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵数乘
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: kA = (kaᵢⱼ)

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵乘法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: C = AB，其中 cᵢⱼ = Σ aᵢₖ · bₖⱼ

extracted_concepts.name: 方阵的幂
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Aⁿ = A · A · ... · A（n 次）

extracted_concepts.name: 逆矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 AB = BA = I，则 B 称为 A 的逆矩阵

extracted_concepts.name: 可逆
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 方阵存在逆矩阵的性质

extracted_concepts.name: 行列式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 记作 |A|，用于判定方阵是否可逆

extracted_concepts.name: 伴随矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 记作 adj(A)，用于求逆公式

extracted_concepts.name: 求逆
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 求方阵逆矩阵的过程

extracted_concepts.name: 求逆公式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A⁻¹ = adj(A) / |A|

extracted_concepts.name: 可逆判定定理
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 方阵 A 可逆的充分必要条件是 |A| ≠ 0

extracted_concepts.name: 转置的性质
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (A^T)^T = A，(A+B)^T = A^T+B^T，(kA)^T = kA^T，(AB)^T = B^T A^T

extracted_concepts.name: 逆矩阵的性质
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (A⁻¹)⁻¹ = A，(AB)⁻¹ = B⁻¹A⁻¹，(A^T)⁻¹ = (A⁻¹)^T

extracted_concepts.name: 矩阵乘法不满足交换律
aliases: 矩阵乘法交换律不成立
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 一般情况下 AB ≠ BA

extracted_concepts.name: 线性方程组
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 可用矩阵形式 Ax = b 表示的方程组

extracted_concepts.name: 系数矩阵
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ax = b 中的矩阵 A

extracted_concepts.name: 未知数向量
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ax = b 中的向量 x

extracted_concepts.name: 常数项向量
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ax = b 中的向量 b

extracted_concepts.name: 唯一解
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 线性方程组存在唯一解
